info.name: USA Limousine Corporation API
info.description:
USA Limousine Corporation API. Variables live on this collection (no separate environment required).

Super admin flow:
1. Run Auth (Super Admin) → Login (saves access/refresh tokens automatically).
2. Call admin routes (Applications, Vehicle Categories, Vehicle Category Pricing, Luggage, Bookings, Payments).
3. If you get 401, run Login again (access token expired).

## Offer marketplace flow (logged-in customer — inDrive style)
1. Public → Vehicle Categories / Luggage → set `vehicle_category_id` (and luggage ids if needed).
2. Customers → Auth → Login (saves `customer_access_token`).
3. Customers → Bookings → **1. Create** → One Way / Hourly / Return / Crew Ride — `POST /customers/bookings` → **SEEKING_OFFERS**. Saves `booking_id`.
4. Drivers → Auth → Login; Presence → Go Online near pickup.
5. Drivers → Offers → **1. Available** / **2. Actions** → Submit Quote. Saves `offer_id`.
6. Customers → Bookings → **2. Offers** → Nearby Drivers (map) / List Offers.
7. **2. Offers** → Accept Offer — **AWAITING_PAYMENT** + Stripe `checkout_url`.
8. Open `{{checkout_url}}`, pay with test card `4242 4242 4242 4242`.
9. Stripe CLI: `stripe listen --forward-to http://localhost:3000/api/v1/payments/webhooks/stripe`
10. After webhook: booking **CONFIRMED**, Trip created for accepted driver.
11. Optional: Decline Offer / Cancel Seeking / Withdraw Quote; customer can rate driver after trip complete.

Admin prepaid path (ops): Super Admin → Bookings → Create/Confirm still notifies available bookings; Drivers → Trips → Accept Trip for **CONFIRMED** bookings without an accepted offer.

WebSocket (optional):
- Customer: JWT connect → user room; `offer.created` / `offer.updated`.
- Driver: `driver:{id}` room; receives `offer.request` and `offer.result`.

Driver delete account: `POST /drivers/delete-request` only (sets INACTIVE; no get/cancel). Admin approve/reject under Admin → Drivers → Delete Requests.

## Ride chat (after trip start)
1. Driver starts trip → chat ACTIVE (`chat.conversation.opened`).
2. Drivers / Customers → **Chat** → Resolve (auto-read) → Send Message.
3. Peer in chat room → delivered + read ticks; offline → FCM then auto-read on open.
4. No mark-read REST/WS client API — receipts are automatic.
5. Complete/cancel deletes chat history.
6. Socket.IO `chat.*` for realtime; REST for poll/resync (`after=`).

item.name: 3. Process

request.description: `PENDING` → `APPROVED`. Writes `PayoutEvent`: `APPROVED`. Audit: `payout.approved`. Notification: `PAYOUT_APPROVED`.
`APPROVED` → `PROCESSING`. Writes `PayoutEvent`: `PROCESSING`. Required before mark paid.
`PROCESSING` → `PAID` (happy path). Writes `PayoutEvent`: `PAID`. Creates wallet `PAYOUT_DEBIT`. Audit: `payout.paid`. Notification: `PAYOUT_PAID`.

`PENDING`, `APPROVED`, or `PROCESSING` → `REJECTED`. Writes `PayoutEvent`: `REJECTED` (`metadata.failureReason`). Audit: `payout.rejected`. Notification: `PAYOUT_REJECTED`. Body: `{ reason, notes? }`.

item.description:
Run the payout settlement flow **in order** after a driver request.

Happy path: **01 Approve** → **02 Mark Processing** → **03 Mark Paid** (wallet `PAYOUT_DEBIT`).

Alternate: **Reject** from `PENDING`/`APPROVED`/`PROCESSING`.

Use **1. List → List Pending** and **2. Get by ID** first to set `{{payout_id}}`.

request.description: Get payout detail including bank account snapshot.

item.description:
Driver payout settlement (`SUPER_ADMIN`).

**Workflow:** driver request (`PENDING`) → approve → mark processing → mark paid (`PAYOUT_DEBIT` on wallet).

## PayoutLifecycleEvent (database)

Each action appends a `PayoutEvent` row (`event`, `previousStatus`, `newStatus`, optional `metadata`).

| Event | When | Status |
|-------|------|--------|
| `CREATED` | Row inserted on request | → `PENDING` |
| `SUBMITTED` | Same TX as create | `PENDING` → `PENDING` |
| `APPROVED` | Admin approve | `PENDING` → `APPROVED` |
| `PROCESSING` | Admin mark processing | `APPROVED` → `PROCESSING` |
| `PAID` | Admin mark paid | `APPROVED`/`PROCESSING` → `PAID` |
| `REJECTED` | Admin reject | `PENDING`/`APPROVED` → `REJECTED` |
| `CANCELLED` | Driver cancel | `PENDING` → `CANCELLED` |
| `RECONCILED` | Reconcile repair | `PAID` → `PAID` |

## Audit log

`payout.requested` · `payout.approved` · `payout.paid` · `payout.rejected` · `payout.cancelled`

## Driver notifications (`driver.notification.created`)

`PAYOUT_SUBMITTED` · `PAYOUT_APPROVED` · `PAYOUT_PAID` · `PAYOUT_REJECTED` · `PAYOUT_CANCELLED`

request.description: Includes `rejectionReason` when `approvalStatus=REJECTED`, and `nextStep=resubmit`.

`POST /drivers/:id/details`

Saves address, work schedule, operating area, spoken languages, and whether the driver dresses in a suit for work.

### `dressesInSuit` (required boolean)
- `true` = yes, dresses in a suit for work
- `false` = no

### Languages (industrial)
- ISO 639-1 `code` + `fluency` per item
- Multi-select: min 1, max 20, unique codes
- Codes must be from the server allowlist (en, nl, tr, ar, de, fr, … ~50 common languages)
- Fluency: `FLUENT` | `CONVERSATIONAL` | `NORMAL`
- Re-submit replaces the full list

Mobile: searchable multi-select from the catalog; send only selected `{ code, fluency }` rows.

`POST /drivers/:id/resubmit-application`

After first-time REJECTED: fix vehicle/docs then call this to return to PENDING review.
No auth. Clears rejectionReason.

item.name: Delete Request

request.description:
`POST /drivers/delete-request`

Driver submits an account delete request (optional `reason`, max 1000 chars).

- Blocks if active/upcoming trips
- Forces offline + sets driver `INACTIVE` (cannot log in until admin acts)
- `409` if a pending request already exists
- No driver get/cancel endpoints — account is locked pending admin review

Admin approve → soft-delete (`deletedAt` + user inactive + sessions revoked).
Admin reject → restore previous status.

item.description: Driver can only submit a delete request. After submit the driver is set `INACTIVE` and cannot log in; admin approve/reject via Admin → Drivers → Delete Requests.

request.description: Current online/offline status, heartbeat liveness, lastLat/lastLng, and open shift session.
Sets driver ONLINE. Requires lat/lng (stored for fleet/map + Redis GEO). Optional fcmToken registers the push token. deviceId binds this session.
End shift + go OFFLINE. deviceId must match the presence device. Clears Redis GEO position for the driver. Not blocked by trip status.

Updates lastHeartbeatAt + coarse map location (lat/lng required). Does **not** force offline if missed — driver stays ONLINE until PATCH /drivers/presence with online:false. Still useful for fleet map freshness while the app is open.
Paginated closed shift sessions (online duration history) via APIFeature.
Delete one closed presence/shift history row owned by the driver.
Delete all closed presence history for the current driver. Open session is kept.

`PATCH /drivers/vehicle`

For APPROVED drivers: creates a **pending change request** (does not overwrite live vehicle).

Blocks if active trip or open change request (409).
Returns `{ message, changeRequestId, status, type }`.

`GET /drivers/vehicle` still returns live approved data + `pendingChange` / `lastRejectedChange`.

`PATCH /drivers/documents`

Same change-request flow as vehicle updates for APPROVED drivers.
Driver notification prefs and timezone (no search radius — location comes from presence).
Update email, push, and/or timezone.

item.name: Chat
item.description:
Driver ride chat (V1 text-only, WhatsApp-style receipts).

**Lifecycle:** unavailable until driver starts → `STARTED` opens ACTIVE chat → complete/cancel **deletes** conversation + history (`chat.conversation.closed`).

**Receipts (server-driven — no mark-read API):**
- Open chat (`chat.join`, Resolve, or Get Conversation) → auto **delivered + read** up to latest.
- Peer already in `chat:<id>` when you send → auto delivered + read (blue tick); no FCM.
- Peer offline → FCM `CHAT_MESSAGE`; ticks catch up when they open chat.
- There is **no** `POST /chat/conversations/:id/read` (removed).

**REST:** resolve → list/get → messages (`before` history / `after` resync) → send.
**Realtime:** `chat.join`, `chat.message.send` / `.created` / `.delivered` / `.read` (S→C), `chat.typing`.
**Limits:** 60 send / 30 typing per user per 60s.

Docs: `apps/backend/docs/websocket-events.md`, `apps/backend/docs/firebase-notifications.md`.

**Audio call:** after Start Ride → Call Token → Agora join. Socket `trip.call`.

request.description:
`GET /trips/:id/chat` (driver JWT). 404 until Start Ride.
Opens chat for the trip and **auto-marks read** (WhatsApp-style). Saves `conversation_id`.
Flow: Start Ride → Resolve → Send. Deleted on complete/cancel.

`POST /trips/:id/call` (driver JWT).

`POST .../call` — Agora audio call token for an **in-progress** trip (same window as chat: after Start Ride through ARRIVED_AT_DROPOFF).
Returns `{ appId, channel, uid, token, expiresAt, mode: "audio" }`.
Also emits Socket `trip.call` (`CALL_INVITE`) on `trip:<id>` / peer rooms.
Peer should request their own token and join the same `channel` with Agora RTC SDK (audio only).
`GET /chat/conversations?limit=&cursor=` — ACTIVE only (deleted on trip complete/cancel). Cursor is opaque `updatedAt|id` from `nextCursor`.
`GET /chat/conversations/:id` — like opening the chat screen: **auto-marks delivered + read** up to the latest message, then returns `unreadCount` (normally 0). Same as Socket `chat.join`.
`GET …/messages?limit=&before=` — older page. Use `before={{message_id}}` or previous `nextCursor`. Do not combine with `after`.
`GET …/messages?after=` — messages after `message_id` (ascending). After reconnect: `chat.join` (auto-read) + this sync. Do not combine with `before`.

`POST …/messages` — text only (max 4000). Idempotent with `clientMessageId`.
If peer is in the chat room → server emits **delivered + read** (blue tick).
If peer offline → FCM; no read until they open chat.
Rate limit 60/min. Saves `message_id`.

request.description:
`GET /customers/bookings/current` (customer JWT).

Returns the customer's active marketplace booking (`SEEKING_OFFERS` or `AWAITING_PAYMENT`) plus live driver offers.

`GET /customers/bookings/:id` (customer JWT).

Booking detail with pending driver offers: `{ booking, offers }`.

`GET /customers/bookings/:id/nearby-drivers`

Online, free drivers near the booking pickup (within matching radius / category).
Returns `pickup`, `radius`, and `drivers[]` with `lat`/`lng`/`distance`/`rating` for map pins.
Poll while SEEKING_OFFERS to refresh the map.

`GET /customers/bookings/:id/offers`

Lists live driver offers for a seeking booking (customer JWT).
Each offer includes quotedPrice, fairPrice, fairPriceDelta, ETA, distance, driver card (stored rating).
Test script saves first pending `offer_id` and `quoted_price`.

`POST /customers/bookings/:id/counter` (customer JWT).

Raise the booking fair/suggested price while **SEEKING_OFFERS**.
Body: `{ "total": number }` — must be **greater** than current `pricing.total`.
Updates Redis session fair price, recalculates offer `fairPriceDelta`, notifies drivers via `booking.available` (`BOOKING_PRICE_UPDATED`) + `offer.request` to tracked drivers.
Returns `{ booking, offers }`.

`POST /customers/bookings/offers/:offerId/accept`

Customer accepts one offer (booking resolved from offerId). Booking → **AWAITING_PAYMENT**. Other pending offers → SUPERSEDED.
Creates Stripe Checkout for the **quotedPrice**.
Saves `payment_id`, `checkout_url`, `checkout_session_id`.
Open `checkout_url` and pay; webhook confirms booking and creates the Trip.

`POST /customers/bookings/offers/:offerId/decline`

Customer declines a single pending offer. Driver gets `offer.result` DECLINED. Session stays SEEKING_OFFERS.

`POST /customers/bookings/:id/cancel-seeking`

Customer cancels the whole offer session. Booking → CANCELLED. Pending offers superseded. Drivers notified.

item.name: Chat
item.description:
Customer ride chat (V1 text-only, WhatsApp-style receipts).

**Lifecycle:** unavailable until driver starts → `STARTED` opens ACTIVE chat → complete/cancel **deletes** conversation + history (`chat.conversation.closed`).

**Receipts (server-driven — no mark-read API):**
- Open chat (`chat.join`, Resolve, or Get Conversation) → auto **delivered + read** up to latest.
- Peer already in `chat:<id>` when you send → auto delivered + read (blue tick); no FCM.
- Peer offline → FCM `CHAT_MESSAGE`; ticks catch up when they open chat.
- There is **no** `POST /chat/conversations/:id/read` (removed).

**REST:** resolve → list/get → messages (`before` history / `after` resync) → send.
**Realtime:** `chat.join`, `chat.message.send` / `.created` / `.delivered` / `.read` (S→C), `chat.typing`.
**Limits:** 60 send / 30 typing per user per 60s.

Docs: `apps/backend/docs/websocket-events.md`, `apps/backend/docs/firebase-notifications.md`.

**Audio call:** after Start Ride → Call Token → Agora join. Socket `trip.call`.

request.description:
`GET /customers/trips/:id/chat` (customer JWT). After driver starts.
Opens chat and **auto-marks read**. Saves `conversation_id`. Deleted on complete/cancel.

`POST /customers/trips/:id/call` (customer JWT).

`POST .../call` — Agora audio call token for an **in-progress** trip (same window as chat: after Start Ride through ARRIVED_AT_DROPOFF).
Returns `{ appId, channel, uid, token, expiresAt, mode: "audio" }`.
Also emits Socket `trip.call` (`CALL_INVITE`) on `trip:<id>` / peer rooms.
Peer should request their own token and join the same `channel` with Agora RTC SDK (audio only).
`GET /chat/conversations?limit=&cursor=` — ACTIVE only (deleted on trip complete/cancel). Cursor is opaque `updatedAt|id` from `nextCursor`.
`GET /chat/conversations/:id` — like opening the chat screen: **auto-marks delivered + read** up to the latest message, then returns `unreadCount` (normally 0). Same as Socket `chat.join`.
`GET …/messages?limit=&before=` — older page. Use `before={{message_id}}` or previous `nextCursor`. Do not combine with `after`.
`GET …/messages?after=` — messages after `message_id` (ascending). After reconnect: `chat.join` (auto-read) + this sync. Do not combine with `before`.

`POST …/messages` — text only (max 4000). Idempotent with `clientMessageId`.
If peer is in the chat room → server emits **delivered + read** (blue tick).
If peer offline → FCM; no read until they open chat.
Rate limit 60/min. Saves `message_id`.
